EngagementInsightType.name: EngagementInsightType
EngagementInsightType.description: Represents the configuration for engagement insight types for voice and video call insights.

ActivatedDateTime.description: The timestamp when the insight type was activated.

AdditionalConfig.description: The additional configuration information specific to the insight type. For example, timing configurations for time-based insights and prompt-based configurations for generative insights.

Category.description: Required. The category of the insight type.

ChannelType.description: The engagement channel used to generate the insight.

Description.description: The description of the insight type.

DeveloperName.description: Required. The unique name for the EngagementInsightType object.

ExternalIdentifier.description: The ID generated for each insight type.

InsightModel.description: Required. The computational model that the user selects to generate the insight.

InsightName.description: Required. The name of the insight.

Language.description: The language used in the insight type.

MasterLabel.description: Required. Label for the insight type.

SpeakerType.description: Specifies if the participant is internal (internal rep), external (customer), or either (not sure). It indicates the 'Said by' field in the UI.

Status.description: The status of the insight type.

SupportedLanguageList.description: The list of languages supported for the insight type.

UsageType.description: The industry where the insight type is applicable.
